meta.title: Two bids on two lines: award line-wise: line 1 to B, line 2 to A; approver rejects
gaps: The prepared event has only one line item and one vendor, so the requested two-line allocation to Vendor B and Vendor A with totals 900, 250, and 1,150 cannot be exercised.
Submitting the proposal with the requested allocation and verifying that no purchase order is created cannot be completed from the one-line, one-vendor prepared state.
Rejecting the proposal as a separate approver and verifying that the buyer can restart awarding requires another user session and has no catalog step.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The prepared event has only one line item and one vendor, so the requested two-line allocation to Vendor B and Vendor A with totals 900, 250, and 1,150 cannot be exercised.; Submitting the proposal with the requested allocation and verifying that no purchase order is created cannot be completed from the one-line, one-vendor prepared state.; Rejecting the proposal as a separate approver and verifying that the buyer can restart awarding requires another user session and has no catalog step.

steps.note: Open the prepared event's Master QCS, the closest available starting screen for awarding.
Enter the awarding screen where line allocations and awarded-vendor counters are managed.

args.goal: allocate line 1 to Vendor B for 10 units at 90 and line 2 to Vendor A for 5 units at 50, confirm Awarded Vendors shows 2/2, create the proposal, fill all required proposal fields, submit it, and stop on the submitted proposal

steps.note: Attempt the buyer-side line-wise allocation and proposal submission; this will expose the prepared state's missing second line or vendor if the requested scenario cannot be reached.

args.need: sign in as the approver, open the submitted proposal, reject it with a remark, and verify that no purchase order is created and the buyer can start awarding again from Master QCS

steps.note: The catalog has no step for switching to the separate approver identity, rejecting a proposal, or checking the post-rejection restart and no-PO outcome.
